name: cpcp-template-rails-app
description: Start a Rails application that serves a CPCP seam. Rails at root, standard layout; the CPCP parts are a mount, a projection, and a manifest.

contract.note: The revision defining this kind, rule 10, and the scope and role vocabularies a copy of this template will use.

reference_instance.note: A running Rails application built this way. An agent reading this template can fetch that CID, see the real operations, call them, and check its own client against actual responses -- which is what rule 10 is for. bin/check-template.rb fetches it and compares.
reference_instance.verified: 2026-09-07: HTTP 200, publishes exactly the three operations above

role_when_copied.name: BACK
role_when_copied.note: A copy of this template is a BACK: it serves the /_cpcp seam. The copy declares its own role block; this template declares none because a template reifies nothing -- it is copied, not run.

layout.convention: Rails at root, standard `rails new` layout.
layout.because: A template is judged by whether the people who will copy it recognise it. A Ruby developer opening this expects app/, config/, bin/, test/ where Rails puts them; anything else is a puzzle before the first useful line.

gates.bin/check-template.rb: Structure, manifest, and the live reference instance. Ruby, because a Rails developer should be able to read the check that judges their repo.
gates..github/workflows/template.yml: Runs bin/check-template.rb AND the contract's check-repo-format.py. Neither subsumes the other: the format checker holds the .cpcp manifests, the template validator holds everything this template claims that is not a manifest.

not_included.a database: A copy runs `rails new` conventions and brings its own. This template carries the CPCP seam, not an application.
not_included.the FRONT: A CPCP unit is four roles and this template is one of them. See cpcp-template-javascript-app for a FRONT.
not_included.agent declarations: app/agents/ carries the convention and no agents. An empty roster with a stated reason is a claim; inventing one would be a template asserting capability it has not got.
